subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw preserve the current AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md subagent boundary and route MiniMax Token Plan office workflows through plugin/skill/ClawHub surfaces after live provider proof, or should subagents inherit Token Plan SKILL.md bundles?
rationale: Source confirms the requested SKILL.md restoration would change an intentional context boundary, while the endpoint/auth symptoms need credentialed MiniMax proof before deciding whether the bundled provider contract is wrong.

options.title: Keep boundary and fix narrowly
options.body: Require live MiniMax Token Plan proof, then repair only confirmed MiniMax provider/media behavior and document or publish office workflows through skill/plugin/ClawHub surfaces.

options.title: Expand subagent skill inheritance
options.body: Approve a new subagent skills/bootstrap contract and require focused security, context-size, and regression coverage before implementation.

options.title: Treat office workflows as external
options.body: Close the core issue after documenting the `mmx` workaround or linking a maintained ClawHub skill if maintainers decide no core/plugin gap exists.

recommendation.title: Keep boundary and fix narrowly
recommendation.body: Require live MiniMax Token Plan proof, then repair only confirmed MiniMax provider/media behavior and document or publish office workflows through skill/plugin/ClawHub surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Eva introduced the current subagent bootstrap boundary that maintainers would need to preserve or deliberately expand.
